newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia olein price little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia olein price little changed in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil (CPO) and olein prices were little changed in late trading on Friday, but some easing tendency was seen, traders said.
They said olein prices edged lower from Thursday on expectation of additional supply from state commodity regulator Bulog and also a weakening in the Malaysian market in the afternoon.
One trader in Medan said CPO price was still stable because buyers were making short-covering to meet export commitments made earlier when export taxes were low.
He said, however, olein prices could not withstand downside pressure on the possible Bulog purchase of palm oil from state plantations to stabilise market prices.
Olein in Medan was quoted at 1,425-30 rupiah/kg, 1,455-60 in Jakarta and Surabaya.
